healthy lifestyle = habits that keep your body well, such as exercise and good food
put on weight = to become heavier
lose weight = to become lighter
allergic to = becoming ill when you eat or touch something
vaccination = an injection that protects you from a disease
first aid = simple medical help given before a doctor arrives
ambulance = a vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital
emergency = a serious situation that needs help immediately
painkiller = medicine that reduces pain
recover = to get better after an illness
get over = to become well again after an illness
check-up = a regular visit to a doctor when you are not ill
hurt = to feel pain; to cause pain
broken bone = a bone that has cracked or snapped
feel better = to start recovering after being ill
see a doctor = to visit a doctor because you are ill
hospital = a place where doctors treat people who are very ill or injured
ward = a large room in a hospital with several beds
surgery = a doctor's office; also an operation
A&E = the hospital department for sudden serious problems
